"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"- **Model visibility toggles**: hide individual models from the DSH model

- **Usage"},{"id":"p6s15","text":" statistics**: input / output / cache-read / cache-write tokens,

never pass through DSH (CLI, verification, test calls), which no
session-based statistic can see"},{"id":"p6s18","text":".

There is "},{"id":"p15s2","text":"no separate dashboard page: the old `/agy` URL is gone."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### Path B: Headless / Terminal Only (Standalone CLI)"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"For Linux VPS, SSH remote servers, or headless CI environments:"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"## CLI reference"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Command | Options | Description |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| `dsh-agy login` | `--headless` — print the auth URL and wait for a pasted redirect URL

`--"},{"id":"p21s15","text":"email <email>` — account email | Remove an account |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### Path C: Local Development & Link"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"Requires Node >= 22."},{"id":"p25s1","text":"### About cache hits: why not 99% like DeepSeek V4?"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Bottom line: the cache hit strategy is decided by the model provider's cache
mechanics (for us, Anti"},{"id":"p26s2","text":"gravity's); agy's mechanics differ from DeepSeek's in
two ways, so its hit rate is naturally a notch"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"mechanics differ from DeepSeek's in
two ways, so its hit rate is naturally a notch below DeepSeek's."},{"id":"p27s1","text":"**First, the entry threshold.** DeepSeek's caching is on by default with no
threshold — its very fir"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"st request already hits a previously cached system
prompt. agy's Gemini-tiered models only start cac"},{"id":"p27s3","text":"hing once the request prefix
reaches roughly 16k tokens, while DSH's default bare system prompt is o"},{"id":"p27s4","text":"nly
about 13k — below the line. So every new conversation's first 1-2 requests
are 0%, until the acc"},{"id":"p27s5","text":"umulated messages pass 16k."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"**Second, how fast the cache updates.** DeepSeek refreshes its cache at the
end of every request — o"},{"id":"p28s2","text":"nly the newest message misses each round, giving
near-100%. agy's cache updates lag: this round's ad"},{"id":"p28s3","text":"ditions are not hit in
the next round — they enter the cache roughly two rounds later, and requests
"},{"id":"p28s4","text":"for the same content in between all count as misses. Every round wastes
about 1.5-2× its additions; "},{"id":"p28s5","text":"the long-conversation hit rate keeps rising as
the context grows, bounded by the model's context win"},{"id":"p28s6","text":"long-conversation hit rate keeps rising as
the context grows, bounded by the model's context window."},{"id":"p29s1","text":"**Practical tips**"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- Don't expect 99% from agy: the gap comes from upstream mechanics, with no
room to optimize.
- If y"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"ou have a weird number obsession, stuff some custom content into the
System Prompt (MCP / tool defin"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"itions / roleplay ...)."}],"truncated":true}
